name: Jet Exhaust Unlimited
author: 0k0k4
description: Adds a NEW jet combustion chamber without the over-rev limit (the >200 RPS explosion is disabled for this component only, identified by value=500123). The mod is SELF-CONTAINED: it carries all of its logic and only uses the generic native primitives of the StormFabric loader. The component is injected in memory (clone of the vanilla definition), on demand, in the engine's lookup hook: nothing is written to rom/ or %APPDATA%. Vanilla components are not modified.
